passages.title: How Bees Help Our Food Grow
lines: Many people are afraid of bees, but these small insects are very important to us.
When a bee visits a flower, it drinks a sweet liquid called nectar.
At the same time, a yellow powder called pollen sticks to the bee's body.
When the bee flies to the next flower, some of the pollen falls off.
This helps the flower make seeds and grow fruit.
This process is called pollination.
Apples, strawberries, and pumpkins are some of the foods that need bees.
Scientists say that about one third of the food we eat depends on insects like bees.
However, the number of bees has been going down in many parts of the world.
One reason is that there are fewer wild flowers in cities and on farms.
Some chemicals that people use to kill pests can also hurt bees.
To help bees, some towns have started planting flowers along roads and in parks.
Even a few flower pots on a balcony can give bees a place to eat.
When we protect bees, we also protect the food on our tables.

passages.title: Join the Nature Photo Club!
lines: Do you like taking pictures of animals, plants, or the sky?
The Nature Photo Club is looking for new members this spring.
Meetings: every Tuesday and Thursday, 3:30 to 4:30 p.m., in the art room.
On the first Saturday of each month, we go on a photo walk in Maple Park.
You don't need your own camera. The club has five cameras that members can borrow.
In October, our best photos will be shown at the town culture festival.
Want to try it first? Come to our open meeting on April 12 in the art room.
To join, please give the sign-up form to Ms. Tanaka by April 19.

speaking.introEn: Hello, I'm Riko. Today, I'd like to hear your ideas. When you answer, please give reasons.
speaking.introJa: こんにちは、リコです。きょうは あなたの 考えを ききたいな。こたえる ときは 理由も いってね。

prompts.askJa: この 文を 声に 出して 読んでね。
prompts.readText: Every year, many birds fly thousands of kilometers to find warmer places in winter. They use the sun, the stars, and even the shape of the land to find their way. Scientists are still learning how these small birds travel so far.

prompts.askEn: Some people say children should have homework every day. What do you think? Please give a reason.
prompts.askJa: 「子どもは 毎日 宿題を した ほうが いい」と いう 人が いるよ。あなたは どう 思う？ 理由も いってね。
prompts.sample: I think a little homework every day is good because it helps us remember what we learned. But it shouldn't take too much time.

prompts.askEn: Thank you. Can you tell me one more reason or an example?
prompts.askJa: ありがとう。もう 1 つ 理由か 例を おしえて くれる？
prompts.sample: Also, homework helps us build a good habit. For example, I study for twenty minutes after dinner, so I don't forget new English words.

writing.promptEn: QUESTION: Is it better to read books on paper or on a tablet? Write your opinion and two reasons in 50-60 words.
writing.promptJa: しつもん: 本は 紙で 読む ほうが いい？ それとも タブレットで 読む ほうが いい？ じぶんの 意見と 理由を 2 つ、50〜60 語で 書こう。
writing.sample: I think it is better to read books on paper. First, I can read for a long time without getting tired because paper is easier on my eyes. Second, I enjoy turning the pages, and I can see how much I have read. For these reasons, I prefer paper books to tablets.
